results.text: Hydrophilic metformin and hydrophobic biguanides inhibit mitochondrial complex I by distinct mechanisms. Metformin is the only antihyperglycemic biguanide targeting type 2 diabetes mellitus with proven safety. Although a mechanism of action involving tight inhibition of the respiratory complex I has been proposed for hydrophobic biguanides, it remains elusive for the hydrophilic metformin, whose excellent pharmacological tolerance depends on weak complex I inhibition without competitive nature.
